GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2020-09-25T10:35:47Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Switch space on currently focused monitor
Description: Hi, this is more of a question. I was wondering if it is possible to tell yabai to switch space based on where the mouse is?

I have two monitors and I want to be able to use a shortcut to switch spaces based on where the mouse, like this:

```
yabai -m space --focus 2 --display mouse
```

Unfortunately `--display mouse` seems to move the mouse in the second space

Is something like this possible?
